query: How does the battery of the Google Pixel 3 hold up during a full day, and do owners report unexpected drain?

It would also unexpectedly shut off with 10-15% charge remaining. Though, I should say it was unexpected when the phone didn't die until it got down below 5% because it almost always shut down somewhere between 10 and 20% charge remaining. Even with battery saver mode permanently enabled, the phone could barely get through a work day. Battery life is going to be hit or miss with a used device so I give it some leeway, but this Pixel's battery was significantly worse than any smartphone I've ever had even after years of use. Overall, the phone was a decent value for the money. I got it at a good price here on Amazon ($100) and when it was holding a charge, the phone worked well aside from the "Phone" app.
Battery doesn't hold a charge very long.

New Unit 2019. Unit is indeed new but was manufactured in 2019. Hence the battery life is not the same as brand new unit. Otherwise the unit works excellent. Update: The battery is doing great . I get almost two full days of battery life.

Improve battery life. This is for personal use but battery drains after I charge it to hundred points then it drains out so fast it's down to zero in 3 to 5 hrs what's causing that as soon as I unplug the charger it starts draining down immediately

Battery is basically dead. Clearly a very rough refurb. Scuffs everywhere but I can live with it. However, the battery drains 20% every 15 minutes, so its clear this refurb was not really refurbished at all.

Battery doesn't hold a charge. I bought this phone in September 2019, but the battery already needs to be charged midday on medium level usage. By contrast, my 2 year old Nexus 5X was still lasting the whole day when I bought the Pixel 3. Is this normal, or did I get a dud?
Battery life? What battery life?. The battery life sucks. Just having the phone on standby will drain it from 100% to 85% over the course of an hr. Other than that, it's a good overall phone

battery seems shot. have had this for a while now. no sim card, just using as basically a mini tablet. even with all radio off except wifi and battery saver mode, constantly having to recharge. will not last a full day without a charge or two. dunno if that was typical of these phones or if i just got a weak unit. will replace the battery eventually

When will you get it right, Google?. This phone is not for anyone who would have a screen on time of more than 4 hours in a day. The irony is, I was able to drain the battery by listening YouTube music for about 5 hours. Which makes me feel that they have the same battery usage as YouTube itself. Also, if you are a Verizon user, these unlocked phones won’t support mobile hotspot or wi-fi calling.

Beware defective batteries. [[VIDEOID:7b016b5553f8af9df6e7f791263c3556]] Phone arrived with totally dead battery, which concerned me since phone was supposed to be refurbished with a guaranteed battery capacity (it shouldn’t have drained completely during shipping). Charged all day to 100%. Let un-setup phone, sit OFF, all night. Battery mostly dead next day, so obviously defective battery or internal short. Contacted Amazon for replacement. Process didn't match their pre-selected bubbles so contacted customer service human. She was in a very noisy environment and I couldn't hear her. When I asked her to try to quiet the background or speak up, she hung up on me. So I tried the CHAT. The support person didn't know what a phone battery was and couldn't follow my concerns so I gave up and ordered a replacement. The original purchase was paid for as an Amazon refurb, from Amazon, in Excellent condition with Amazon backing.
1/2 day battery. Phone was rad af. Battery was trash. Sent it back

Above Expectations. After reading the reviews I had a lot of worries. I wasn't sure how good the battery would be but I have tested it and so far so good. I had my son use it for a few hours playing games and videos on it and we let it sit off a charger for over 15 hrs afterwards. After 24 hrs off charger starting from fully charge there was still 40% battery left. This is above my expectations and so far I am satisfied. I have a total of 90 days to try this out but if it continues to work as good as it currently works I find that 90 days I will still enjoy what I got.

It was new and works fine. I am reasonably sure it really was new; that or they did an extraordinary job of repackaging it. I bought 2, but have only used 1 so far, so this review is based on that. It is pretty much what I expected and I like it; but the poor battery life stops me from giving it 5 stars. To be fair, sometimes the battery takes a few cycles before it gets full strength; lets hope.
Wasn't great. The battery only lasted half a day.

Bad battery in used phone. Loved the phone, but I ordered a used one (which was in excellent physical condition) and the battery drained with no use. When using the phone (just to text or look up the weather, etc.) it would lose a percentage about every other minute. I am returning it and going to try my luck with one that is not used since I want this phone for its camera quality!

BAD BATTERY LIFE & BAD BATTERY CONNECTION. BAD BATTERY LIFE & BAD BATTERY CONNECTION Got this phone in Nov for a Christmas gift for my son. He has complained about the battery in January but didn't make it that clear to me that it was a problem. Mid MARCH he said he now has to bring his charger to work because the phone drains fast. WARRANTY BEGINS AT PURCHASE DATE, per seller. I would NOT recommend this phone, NOT reliable.
Great product will deal with them again. This is used on a daily basis all day and the battery lasts longer than I expected, and it's been replaced for free!

I had to recharge this phone 3 times in one day. My old moto e 6 I can run a whole day and a half using it before charging but this pixel phone has to be charged OFTEN and I don't do much on my phone at all, just some texting and my email coming through once a day that is it. I do not play games on it or do any social media on it and still it needed charged 3 times in one day. Looking at battery use, it wasn't showing anything using that much battery. I also don't like that hte battery is not replaceable. In my older moto e6 phone I have a replacable battery.
Battery not “Refreshed”. The handset appeared to be in decent shape, but the battery was spent and would not hold a charge. It was a waste of time to try this.
